Context

  • GitHub account: 2114 days old, 37 public repositories

What they want to do:

Approve grants 25 credits on Sonnet 5.5 unless your reply says credits=<n> or model=opus. Deny's reply is the reason the applicant reads. Ask's reply is emailed to them as a question. Dismissing this files it again: deny instead.

Options

Pick an option to resolve, or dismiss to close without choosing.

  • approve Approve Approve: provision the land with 25 credits on Sonnet 5.5. To change either, reply credits=<n> and/or model=opus. → report The land is created and the applicant is emailed a sign-in link.
  • deny Deny Deny: your reply is the reason the applicant reads. → report Closes the application; no land is created.
  • ask Ask Ask: your reply is emailed to the applicant as a question, and the application stays open. → report The decision is filed again when they reply.
